name: shaded_blades
source: shaded_blades, authored as 11 control points as the albedo of the shaded_blades style: the reference's blades by lightness decile, warm and cool interleaved so a few cycles over the trap's entry step give neighbouring blades different hues (near-black, maroon, slate, copper, blue-grey, cream), each more saturated than the reference's means, since the light's sheen and the tone pass grey them, and its top end (cream and pale silver) held a step darker than the reference's, since the style's light supplies the sheen and a frame filled by one cream blade otherwise reads p90 high.
